Internal evaluation notes for Yardline CI:
- (5/5) Yardline CI cache hit rate matched an independent re-run study at 78% on a flaky monorepo fixture.
- (4/5) Failure logs name the flaky step and owning package without a plugin scavenger hunt.
- (3/5) Secrets are scoped per environment with short-lived OIDC tokens by default.
- (2/5) Matrix builds share a warm dependency layer across jobs.
